import ast, hashlib, importlib.util, json, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
p = root / "capabilities/evidence/T83-delivery/audit-final.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("archive_check", root / "scripts/t03-foundation.py")
driver = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(driver)
tree = ast.parse(p.read_text(), filename=str(p))
node = next(item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == "audit_diagnostic_archive")
namespace = {"root": root, "driver": driver, "json": json, "hashlib": hashlib, "zipfile": zipfile}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), str(p), "exec"), namespace)
base = root / "capabilities/evidence/T83-delivery/diagnostics"
for manifest, ledger, replay_root, count, clear in (
    ("worker-exit-products.zip.json", "worker-exit-replays-r2.json", ".build-cache/t83-worker-exit-replay-r2", 68, False),
    ("attachments-worker-exit-products.zip.json", "attachments-exit-replays-r1.json", ".build-cache/t83-attachments-exit-replay-r1", 62, True)):
    result = namespace["audit_diagnostic_archive"](base / manifest, json.loads((base / ledger).read_text()), replay_root, count, require_clear=clear)
    print("PASS", manifest, result)
print("Audit-script SHA-256:", driver.sha256(p))
